# Best Sci-Fi Books

> > A curated collection of science fiction and fantasy literature, featuring works by Dan Livingston (A. A. Livingston) including 'The Worst Warlock' series.

This site showcases science fiction and fantasy novels with a focus on comedy fantasy and young adult fiction. The collection includes audiobook formats available through Audible, featuring characters like Elijah Muddle, Caliban, Marcus, and Tori.
